issue.title: test_foreground_run_records_context_usage_and_grant intermittently records peak_tree_rss_kib == 0

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposing bead: sase-1ez.2 note #3 (watchdog-truth phase) saw the assertion usage["peak_tree_rss_kib"] > 0 (tests/tool/test_demand_runs.py:261) fail during sase tool run check and said it reproduced on a clean base tree (git stash -u), with nothing in the watchdog-truth files involved. The sase-1ex.2 notes also list 'test_demand_runs peak_tree_rss' among 3 load-flaky tests. Independent check by sase-1ez.land at master 54427ed47c (serial, single-node runs, otherwise-idle pytest process): 1 failure in 10 runs, the other 9 passed. Likely cause is still unconfirmed: the foreground snippet can exit before the tree-RSS sampler takes a non-zero sample, so tree_rss_samples >= 1 can pass while the peak stays 0. The fix should make the sampler always take one sample before the child exits, or relax the assertion to match the sampler's documented semantics.

payload.description: Rank 8. Fix the zero peak-RSS flake in the demand-run test.

payload.entry: Fixed by phase sase-1i5.6. Root cause: the executor took a single tree-RSS sample per short run; when the child exited before the sample, the scan read its unreaped zombie as RSS 0 (probed: zombie scans always read 0), recording peak_tree_rss_kib=0 with tree_rss_samples=1. Fix: build_resource_usage floors a missing/zero peak at wait4 ru_maxrss (measured, darwin-normalized; never when tree sampling is unavailable), and the first tree sample moved to immediately after spawn in executor_run.py. Verified: previously-failing node failed ~50% pre-fix on this host; post-fix 50/50 serial passes, 20/20 under 8-way parallel load, full tests/tool/ 463 passed 1 skipped, new regression tests (5 unit + 1 instant-child end-to-end in tests/tool/test_demand_resources.py, tests/tool/test_demand_runs.py) fail pre-fix and pass post-fix.
